meta.title: Dental Website Prospects - Verified Research
meta.verification_note: Every website was fetched and audited live on 2026-08-19. Every follower count and last-post date was read from the live Instagram profile the same day. No prospect is fabricated.
unscored_criteria: page_speed - no Lighthouse or performance tooling available; deliberately not scored
mobile_responsiveness - no device emulator available; deliberately not scored
known_limitations: Instagram reliably exposes only the LATEST post date, not full posting cadence. activity_frequency is 'not verified' unless the profile made it evident.
Reaching a verified 100 would require roughly 300+ additional live fetches; research was stopped at the point of an actionable list rather than padded with unchecked names.

prospects.specialty: General and cosmetic; digital dentistry, guided implant surgery, same-day crowns
website_weaknesses: Footer reads verbatim: 'DESIGN AND CONTENT (c) 2013-2026 BY DENTALFONE' - stock template platform with lineage dating to 2013
No online booking at all - contact form and phone only
Zero testimonials or reviews anywhere on the homepage
No before/after gallery despite marketing cosmetic dentistry
SVG placeholders rendering instead of real practice photography
Legacy domain jchandds.com 301-redirects in, but Google still indexes a 'A Coming Soon Landing Page' URL on it
prospects.social_profile_url: Instagram, Facebook, Google and Yelp all linked from site footer
prospects.growth_trigger: Brand-new practice (opened 2025) running an active PR campaign - PRNewswire release plus pickups in Dentistry Today and Dentistry33
prospects.opening_message: Dr. Chan - I read the release about Waimea Dental Studio opening at Carter Professional Center. Two things stood out when I looked at the site: there's no way for a new patient to actually book, and jchandds.com still has a 'Coming Soon' page indexed on Google. For a practice built around same-day crowns and guided implant surgery, the site is doing you a disservice. I build booking-first sites for practices exactly at your stage.
prospects.recommended_offer: Full custom rebuild off Dentalfone, real scheduler integration, case gallery, local SEO and redirect cleanup
prospects.price_rationale: New owner, premium tech positioning, single location, PR momentum to capitalise on. He is already paying for attention; the site is the weakest link in that funnel.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Highest ratio in this list of money already spent on attention to the site's ability to convert it.

prospects.city: Atlanta, GA and Beverly Hills, CA
prospects.specialty: Facial aesthetic dentistry, minimal-prep and no-prep veneers, smile design
website_weaknesses: Instagram bio link is a raw Calendly URL with a hardcoded 2023 month parameter: calendly.com/artofaestheticsdental/drjess?month=2023-07 - a 140K-follower account routing traffic through a three-year-stale scheduling link instead of a landing page
No before/after gallery on a site whose own headline is 'Where dentistry meets design' - for a veneer practice this is the single most costly omission
No pricing or financing transparency on a premium cosmetic offer
Team presentation thin ('Dr. Q and Dr. Jess' only) for a two-city operation
prospects.activity_frequency: Frequent - both accounts posted within the last week
prospects.growth_trigger: Bicoastal expansion - Atlanta plus Beverly Hills. Press: featured on Atlanta News First
prospects.best_outreach_channel: Instagram DM (she runs DM consults), then email
prospects.opening_message: Dr. Jess - 140K people follow your veneer work, and the link in your bio is a Calendly URL still carrying a 2023 date parameter. There's also no before/after gallery on theartofaesthetic.com, which for a minimal-prep veneer practice is the one thing a prospective patient wants most. I'd build you a conversion page that actually holds that audience - Atlanta and Beverly Hills split properly.
prospects.recommended_offer: Premium cosmetic site plus dedicated smile-gallery build plus per-location conversion funnels replacing the Calendly link
prospects.price_rationale: Two locations, large engaged audience, premium cosmetic price points, celebrity-adjacent positioning. Highest-ticket prospect on this list.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Enormous existing demand, demonstrably leaking through a stale link.

prospects.specialty: Cosmetic dentistry, veneers, plus a paid dental education business
website_weaknesses: The live site displays the banner: 'The trial period has expired please purchase if you like to continue using the theme' - an unlicensed-theme notice sitting on a page selling a GBP 299 course and a GBP 997 Inner Circle membership
Dated interface despite genuinely premium content (4K video production, 11 modules)
Built on Kajabi with an expired third-party theme - brand-damaging at that price point
prospects.last_activity: 2025-08-31 - approximately 12 months stale. Heavily penalised per the activity rules.
prospects.growth_trigger: Active course launch with launch-week discount code ('SandraBigSmile'), tiered pricing, student pricing
prospects.best_outreach_channel: Email via veneerschool.com; Instagram DM secondary (may be unattended)
prospects.opening_message: Dr. Martin - I was looking at Veneer School and there's an expired-theme banner rendering on the live sales page: 'The trial period has expired please purchase if you like to continue using the theme.' It's sitting above a GBP 997 membership offer. That one line costs you credibility with exactly the dentists you're trying to enrol. I can have a clean, properly licensed sales page up quickly.
prospects.recommended_offer: Course sales-page rebuild plus checkout flow. Fast, high-urgency, tightly defined scope.
prospects.price_rationale: A single high-impact sales page, not a clinic site. Priced for speed because the problem is actively bleeding revenue.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: The most concrete, undeniable, revenue-linked defect found in this entire research pass. Impossible to argue with.
prospects.caveat: Instagram dormant approximately 12 months. Confirm the business is still trading before investing heavily.

prospects.owner_name: Dr. Adam Persky and Dr. Silva Battaglin
prospects.specialty: Concierge cosmetic dentistry, smile design, veneers, implants, original UFC mouthguard makers
website_weaknesses: www.smilesketchvegas.com fails DNS resolution entirely (ENOTFOUND) - while their Instagram bio advertises exactly that address. The URL their own profile promotes does not resolve.
The apex domain returns essentially nothing but a <title> tag to a non-JavaScript fetch - client-side-rendered with no server-rendered content. Bad for search crawling and link previews.
No auditable testimonials, gallery, or booking surfaced at all
prospects.activity_frequency: Active - posting within the last week
prospects.growth_trigger: Concierge positioning plus dental tourism plus UFC mouthguard niche - premium, marketable, high-margin
prospects.opening_message: The link in your bio - www.smilesketchvegas.com - doesn't resolve. The www version returns a DNS error, and the plain domain serves almost no readable content to Google. You're posting consistently and pointing traffic at an address that partly breaks. For a concierge practice doing UFC mouthguards, that's a real leak. I can fix the DNS and rebuild it properly.
prospects.recommended_offer: Emergency DNS/hosting fix, then full server-rendered rebuild with booking and smile gallery
prospects.price_rationale: Premium concierge positioning, dental tourism (high-value out-of-town patients), two owner-dentists.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: A broken front door on an actively-marketed premium practice. Urgent and provable.

prospects.owner_name: Dr. Cyrus Safizadeh and Dr. Noelle Nubani
prospects.specialty: Family and pediatric dentistry, special-needs care
website_weaknesses: Site simultaneously lists two different addresses - '207 Russell Street' (old) and '101 East Street' (new). A patient cannot tell which office to drive to.
A 'Construction' item is still live in the main navigation months after the building opened
Two conflicting sets of office hours on the same site (Tue-Sat vs Mon-Fri)
No testimonials; no footer attribution; generic copy ('Dentistry & More!')
prospects.best_social_platform: Instagram and Facebook (icons present on site)
prospects.social_profile_url: Icons present on site; profile URLs not exposed in page content
prospects.growth_trigger: Approximately $3 million investment in a new 4,600 sq ft facility, grand opening May 2026; hired Dr. Europa Yang, board-certified pediatric dentist. Coverage in WWLP, Daily Hampshire Gazette, BusinessWest.
prospects.opening_message: Congratulations on the East Street opening - I saw the WWLP coverage of the $3M build. One thing worth fixing quickly: hampshiremeadowdental.com still lists 207 Russell Street alongside 101 East Street, shows two different sets of opening hours, and still has 'Construction' in the top navigation. After that kind of investment, the site is the one place still describing the old practice.
prospects.recommended_offer: Full rebuild reflecting the new facility, single source of truth for address/hours, pediatric and special-needs service architecture, real booking
prospects.price_rationale: A practice that just spent $3M and hired a specialist has budget and an obvious mandate to look the part.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Textbook trigger - major capital investment, and the website contradicts itself on basic facts.

prospects.specialty: Veneers, Lumineers, full-mouth reconstruction, Invisalign, CEREC
website_weaknesses: Footer reads verbatim: 'Designed by O360 | Optimized360 LLC (c) 2020 All Rights Reserved' - a six-year-old agency template, unmaintained
No integrated online booking at all - every CTA routes to a contact form or phone, despite the practice holding 1,300+ reviews
Duplicate navigation menus rendering twice
Financing (Cherry) mentioned without terms

prospects.growth_trigger: Only dentist in the city offering Smile Virtual consultations; dedicated out-of-town patient programme (dental tourism); multi-year 'America's Top Dentist' awards

The footer still reads 'Optimized360 LLC (c) 2020,' so the site hasn't had real attention in six years. With that much trust already earned, the booking gap is the expensive part.

prospects.price_rationale: 45-year-old practice, premium cosmetic case mix, large review moat, clear dental-tourism revenue line.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Enormous accumulated trust throttled by a six-year-old template with no booking.

prospects.owner_name: Dr. Sanjeev Bhatia and Dr. Hemani Kaur
prospects.specialty: Cosmetic, implant, prosthodontics, full-mouth reconstruction, sedation
website_weaknesses: Two competing domains for one brand - esthetiquedentistry.com (multi-location: Ashburn / Frederick MD / Stamford CT) and esthetiquedentistryashburn.com (Ashburn only). They compete in search and split authority.
The Ashburn site returned only meta tags to a standard fetch - no server-rendered body content, a real crawlability and link-preview problem
Address inconsistency across sources: 44121 Leesburg Pike in the press release vs 44345 Premier Plz in directories

Worth knowing: you have two separate domains for the same brand competing in Google, and the Ashburn site serves almost no readable content to crawlers. For a newly built implant and cosmetic centre, that's a lot of the launch investment not compounding.
prospects.recommended_offer: Domain consolidation plus server-rendered rebuild plus multi-location architecture
prospects.price_rationale: Multi-site group, prosthodontist on staff, full-mouth reconstruction case values.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Newly built premium centre whose launch spend is being split across two competing domains.

prospects.specialty: Invisalign, implants, veneers, composite bonding

You don't own that domain, which permanently caps what your SEO can do. Worth owning the asset you're driving all this traffic to.

prospects.price_rationale: Established UK practice actively spending on promotion, but regional market pricing.
prospects.why_worth_contacting: Driving paid promotional traffic to a domain they do not own.

outcome_analysis.conversion_rate: Deliberately not estimated. There is no evidential basis for one, and anyone quoting a number is guessing.
structural_strengths: 10 of 10 have a defect statable in one sentence with a URL - not a matter of taste
7 of 10 have a growth trigger dated within the last 12 months (new practice, new building, new location, new accreditation, active campaign)
9 of 10 have a directly identifiable owner-decision-maker
6 of 10 are reachable via a channel they personally operate (Instagram DM, LinkedIn) rather than a front desk
realistic_outcomes: Most likely: the majority do not reply at all. Cold outreach to busy clinician-owners is mostly silence, regardless of quality.
Replies will skew toward orders 1, 2 and 5 - those three have defects that are urgent and embarrassing rather than merely suboptimal, which is what actually triggers a response.

Expect incumbent pushback. Ocean Vibe has Crimson Media, Camacho has Optimized360, Rise has Energize Group, Austin Elite has EGS. You are proposing to displace a paid vendor - lead with the specific defect, never with 'I build websites'.
Deal sizes are not uniform. The spread between a $900 sales page (Martin) and a $7,000 bicoastal build (Dr. Jess) is large. Prioritise by value times likelihood, not by score alone.

Order 1 is the fastest possible win - smallest scope, most undeniable problem, lowest price friction. Worth sending first even though her Instagram is dormant, because the defect is on the sales page, not the social account.
outcome_analysis.sequencing_advice: Send orders 1, 2 and 5 first (urgent/embarrassing defects), then 4 and 7 (high value, DM-reachable), then the rest. Do not send all ten the same day - learn which framing lands before spending your best leads.

further_research.richest_remaining_vein: New-practice announcements. Ideal Practices, Becker's Dental Review, and local-press grand-opening coverage produce a steady stream of dentist-owners with 0-6-month-old template websites and fresh capital.
further_research.obstacle: Becker's Dental Review blocked automated fetching (HTTP 403), so those lists are best mined manually.
further_research.cost_estimate: Each additional verified prospect costs approximately 2-4 live fetches (identify owner, audit site, verify social).
